findings.claim: The three paginated getSubGroupsStream(...) overloads in GroupAdapter (lines 256, 262, 268) still call modelSupplier.get().getSubGroupsStream(...) without a null check. They throw a NullPointerException when the group is deleted concurrently, which is reachable through the GET /admin/realms/{realm}/groups/{id}/children endpoint.

verifier.reason: In model/infinispan/src/main/java/org/keycloak/models/cache/infinispan/GroupAdapter.java:256, 262, and 268, all three paginated getSubGroupsStream(...) overloads dereference modelSupplier.get() without a null check (unlike getSubGroupsCount() at GroupAdapter.java:274-275), even though getGroupModel() (GroupAdapter.java:298-300) returns null when the cached group has been deleted concurrently from the database. This throws a NullPointerException reachable via GET /admin/realms/{realm}/groups/{id}/children, which resolves the cached GroupAdapter in GroupsResource.java:149 and calls group.getSubGroupsStream(search, exact, -1, -1) in services/src/main/java/org/keycloak/services/resources/admin/GroupResource.java:180.

findings.claim: The regression test never joins the background reader thread before asserting on caughtExceptions. The assertion runs immediately after deletedAll.set(true), so exceptions from in-flight reads can be missed and the thread can outlive the test.

verifier.reason: In tests/base/src/test/java/org/keycloak/tests/admin/group/GroupTest.java:139-149, createMultiDeleteMultiReadMulti starts an anonymous Thread without keeping a reference to join it. Immediately after setting deletedAll.set(true) at line 155, line 157 asserts assertThat(caughtExceptions, Matchers.empty()), so exceptions from an in-flight groups() read at line 143 can be missed and the reader thread can outlive the test.
